jobs.description:
The company is a leading international player operating in a highly customer-centric and relationship-driven industry.
In Belgium, it works closely with an extensive network of professional partners, providing innovative solutions, commercial support and expert guidance to help them grow their business.
Backed by a strong culture of innovation and continuous improvement, the company is recognized for its commitment to customer excellence, people development and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

The Account Manager - Optical Sector will have the following responsibilities :

• Drive commercial growth across Flanders by expanding the presence of ophthalmic solutions within targeted healthcare accounts.
• Identify, engage and develop new business opportunities with ophthalmologists, clinics and hospital-based eye care professionals.
• Strengthen partnerships with existing customers while building long-term relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.
• Lead the development of strategic growth areas such as myopia management, leveraging clinical evidence and market insights.
• Promote innovative vision care solutions, including products addressing presbyopia and eye protection needs.
• Design and implement territory plans that translate market opportunities into sustainable business results.
• Act as a trusted advisor to customers by providing expertise on products, market trends, pricing and practice development opportunities.
• Coordinate cross-functional activities, including product implementation, customer training and ongoing support, to ensure a best-in-class customer experience.

• Optometrist
• Proven success in sales (MedTech / Eyecare is a must)
• Hunter profile
• Network in ophthalmology 
• Fluent in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Industry- automation systems warehouse

Our client is a well-established and highly respected real estate agency with a strong presence in the market. Operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, the company is known for its commitment to excellence, client-centric approach, and entrepreneurial mindset. With an international outlook and a diverse portfolio of clients and projects, the agency offers a stimulating workplace where collaboration, professionalism, and innovation are valued. Joining this organization means becoming part of a successful team that thrives on challenge, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide comprehensive administrative and organizational support to the management team.
• Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and organize business travel arrangements.
• Prepare, review, and maintain correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents.
• Act as a key point of contact for clients, tenants, landlords, and external stakeholders, ensuring professional communication at all times.
• Support the coordination and follow-up of real estate transactions, property management activities, and client projects.
• Organize internal and external events, meetings, and client visits.
• Maintain and update databases, CRM systems, and property-related records, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a high level of professionalism.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with CRM or property management systems.

The client is a well-established international premium fashion brand, renowned for its timeless style, exceptional craftsmanship, and strong commitment to quality. Combining heritage with innovation, the company offers sophisticated collections that inspire customers worldwide and delivers a premium retail experience across its stores and digital channels.

Jobomschrijving

As Retail Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the performance of multiple stores, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering outstanding commercial results. Acting as a true brand ambassador, you will play a key role in translating business strategy into action on the shop floor.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive sales growth and profitability across your store portfolio.
• Lead, coach, and develop Store Managers and their teams to achieve ambitious targets.
• Monitor KPIs and implement action plans to maximize performance.
• Ensure a premium customer experience aligned with brand standards.
• Optimize staffing, productivity, and operational efficiency.
• Partner closely with Head Office teams on merchandising, marketing, and retail initiatives.
• Identify opportunities to improve processes and support business growth.
• Foster a positive, engaging, and high-performance culture.

• Proven experience in a multi-site retail management role within fashion, lifestyle, or premium retail.
• Strong commercial mindset with a track record of delivering results.
• Inspirational leader with excellent coaching and people management skills.
• Data-driven and comfortable analyzing performance indicators.
• Passion for customer experience and brand excellence.
• Hands-on, proactive, and adaptable in a fast-paced retail environment.
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Sr KAM Off Trade - Non food company
jobs.description:
The company is a leading international FMCG player in the non-food sector, offering a diverse portfolio of trusted consumer products across categories such as personal care, household, and lifestyle essentials. Known for its strong brands, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to sustainability, it combines global scale with local market expertise. The organization places a strong emphasis on quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement, making it a dynamic and forward-thinking environment within the fast-moving consumer goods industry.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior KAM, you will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of key retail accounts, developing tailored commercial strategies to drive distribution, visibility, and long-term profitable growth. You will act as the primary point of contact for your customers, ensuring strong partnerships and flawless execution in the market.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and develop strategic relationships with key off-trade customers in the non-food channel.
• Negotiate annual agreements, pricing, and promotional plans to deliver sustainable growth.
• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned with customer and company objectives.
• Drive distribution, shelf presence, and visibility of product ranges across retail partners.
• Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer performance to identify opportunities.
• Collaborate closely with marketing, supply chain, and category teams to ensure execution excellence.
• Deliver against sales, profitability, and market share targets.
• Provide regular performance analysis and strategic recommendations to senior management.

• Proven experience in Key Account Management within FMCG, preferably in non-food or general merchandise.
• Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation skills.
• Ability to build long-term, trust-based relationships with retail partners.
• Analytical mindset with strong understanding of sales data and category performance.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented approach.
• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English.

The company is a fast-growing food retail chain known for offering high-quality, fresh, and convenient food options at accessible prices. With a strong focus on customer experience, operational efficiency, and product consistency, it operates a network of locations designed to serve customers on-the-go while maintaining strong brand standards and a welcoming atmosphere.

Jobomschrijving

As District Manager, you will be responsible for the overall performance of multiple stores, ensuring consistent execution of commercial strategies, operational standards, and brand values. You will act as a strategic partner to Store Managers, supporting them in achieving strong business results while fostering a culture of engagement and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and support Store Managers to deliver strong sales, profitability, and operational performance.
• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators, driving corrective actions when needed.
• Ensure consistent implementation of brand standards, food quality, and customer experience.
• Develop and coach teams to build a high-performance and customer-focused culture.
• Optimize operational processes, staffing, and cost efficiency across the district.
• Collaborate with Head Office teams on promotions, merchandising, and business initiatives.
• Identify local market opportunities to drive growth and customer loyalty.
• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and food hygiene regulations.

• Proven experience in multi-site management within food retail, QSR, hospitality, or FMCG retail.
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop teams at scale.
• Commercially minded with a strong focus on KPIs and results.
• Hands-on, pragmatic, and comfortable in a fast-moving environment.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Passion for food, customer experience, and operational excellence.
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.

Searching for a job in Sales? Eager to learn everything from the bottom to the top?
Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a highly self-motivated, results oriented and solutions driven Management Trainee with a general interest in all levels of a business and a general interest in developing new technologies. After completing the management trainee program, you will be assigned to a full-time position in Sales.

The client's management trainee program is designed for recent university graduates who are highly motivated and have the potential to excel as future global leaders at the company. The training program is customized to meet the skills of the employee along with the needs of the company.

It offers challenging work assignments along with hands on training in manufacturing, quality control, administration, sales & marketing, and logistics. You will be exposed to all areas of the business and learn by successfully completing various projects in the different departments.

• A master or bachelor degree.

Lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise applications across back-end and front-end technologies. Architect scalable solutions, apply advanced software design patterns, and mentor junior and medior developers. Utilize the Microsoft ecosystem, modern front-end frameworks, Azure cloud services, messaging platforms, and architectural practices like CQRS, DDD, and Clean Architecture to deliver robust and business-aligned solutions.

• Implement and optimize containerized solutions with Kubernetes, Docker, or AKS

Qualifications

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is a plus

• English + French and / or Dutch

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in the Brabant Wallon
jobs.description:
As part of the finance team, you will take ownership of several legal entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg, with the opportunity to gradually expand your responsibilities and make a visible impact on the organization's future.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the full accounting cycle for several entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.
• Handle daily accounting operations, including purchase invoices, bank transactions, payments, reconciliations, and journal entries.
• Prepare monthly and year-end closings, provisions, accruals, and supporting financial analyses.
• Ensure timely VAT, Intrastat, and statutory reporting obligations are met.
• Prepare annual accounts and support audit activities in collaboration with the Chief Accountant.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes and support ad hoc finance projects.

• Holds a degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent professional experience.
• Speaks fluent French and Dutch ; English is a great asset.
• Has solid end-to-end accounting experience and is comfortable managing entities autonomously.
• Has a strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, VAT, and statutory obligations.
• Is structured, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Demonstrates ambition, curiosity, and a willingness to take on increasing responsibilities over time.
• Thrives in a pragmatic, hands-on, and collaborative environment where initiative is valued.

Are you a natural host who thrives on creating a welcoming and motivating workplace environment? Then this varied Office Manager role within an international company in Brussels could be your next challenge. Apply today!
 

Your responsibilities as an Office Manager:
 

 
• You are the first point of contact in the office, warmly welcoming employees and visitors. You also ensure a smooth onboarding process for new colleagues and contribute to an outstanding workplace experience.
 
• You organise staff events, team-building activities and initiatives that foster employee engagement, team spirit and a positive company culture.
 
• You coordinate health, safety and wellbeing initiatives, ensure compliance with Belgian regulations and arrange relevant prevention and safety training.
 
• You oversee the day-to-day office operations, including supplier management, facilities, meeting rooms, office supplies, catering and other services that support a productive working environment.
 
• You maintain relationships with suppliers, follow up on orders and invoices, and provide administrative and organisational support to the management team. 

Do you recognise yourself in the following profile of an Office Manager?
 

 
• You have experience in Office Management, Hospitality, Facility Management, or a similar support role.
 
• You combine a service-oriented and welcoming attitude with a professional demeanour and a hands-on approach.
 
• You have an excellent command of English, together with a good knowledge of Dutch or French.
 
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office and feel comfortable working with a variety of administrative tools.
 
• Knowledge of health and safety legislation and/or experience with fleet management would be considered a strong asset.

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?
	
• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse	
• Loading and unloading trucks	
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system	
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)	
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace	
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift

	
• You hold a valid forklift certificate	
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters	
• You speak Dutch, French, or English

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).
